title: Independent timelines and acoustic scene alignment
summary: Recordings retain native immutable timelines. An AudioScene may map recordings into a common scene time using assessed affine mappings with separate evidence windows and confidence.
invariants: Common acoustic scene does not imply common recording timeline.
Alignment hypotheses do not rewrite source timestamps.
Offset and drift are assessed independently and may remain unassessed.
A scene-time through-cut maps back to independent local cuts and preserves each view-specific boundary.

provenance.claim: Independent recording timelines and scene-time mappings.
